description: This file defines API endpoint routes for retrieving Near-Earth Objects (NEOs) data, using Flask and related libraries. It includes a MethodView class for handling GET requests to list NEOs by date with pagination.

classes.name: NeosList
classes.description: A Flask MethodView that handles GET requests to list NEOs for a specific date with pagination.

methods.name: None _validate_date(date_str: str)
methods.description: Validates that the provided date string matches the format YYYY-MM-DD, aborting with 400 if invalid.

methods.name: get(self, date: str, page: int, per_page: int)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of NEOs for a given date, calling the data provider and returning the data.

ctags.name: get
ctags.pattern: /^    def get(self, date: str, page: int, per_page: int):$/
ctags.signature: (self, date: str, page: int, per_page: int)
